services.name: Johns Pass Parasail
services.desc: Over the years those who have gone parasailing have been as young as 2 and as “young” as 102. Participants under the age of 18 must have a parent or guardian sign their liability waiver. Minimum combined weight is 130-165 lbs and maximum combined weight about 450-550 lbs. Weight requirements change daily due to wind

blurb: Guests parasail high above the Gulf of Mexico, flying two or three at a time side by side for better views. The company operates three 12-passenger US Coast Guard inspected parasailing boats with licensed captains. Loading and unloading is done at the dock, so guests do not have to get into the water or transfer by shuttle boat.
extraNote: Open year ’round – subject to season and weather conditions · Loading and unloading takes place at the dock at Johns Pass Village and Boardwalk, Madeira Beach. · Open year ’round – subject to season and weather conditions.
